# Semtech SX126x driver provenance

Unmodified files from https://github.com/Lora-net/sx126x_driver, commit a10c5dfdf89788c6ac805e9fe98889de44175aa2 (driver 2.5.0). Included only sx126x.c, its required headers and LICENSE.txt. LR-FHSS, BPSK and example applications are excluded.

License reviewed before reuse: Clear BSD. Keep source notices and reproduce LICENSE.txt in binary distribution materials. The license does not grant patent rights. This dependency's license does not select a license for Reaper Mesh; the project's licensing decision remains deferred.
